turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it on pleasantries. My son found out he had a zero on his Hamlet essay from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start by telling me who decided that and on what basis.
You didn't answer me. Who decided, and on what basis?
Owen is a great kid. Really bright, one of my favourites.
Then why is there a zero next to his name? Don't manage me, Hale. Who entered it, and before or after anyone heard from Owen?
I'm sure this is all just a misunderstanding.
"A misunderstanding." Okay. If it's a misunderstanding, you can withdraw the zero before I leave this room, so is that what you're telling me?
So can we agree he's a good student?
You're leading me, Hale, and I've sat across from better at it for twenty years. His average is 91.2, so yes, and that's exactly why I want to know who put a zero on it without picking up the phone.
